counterexamples: A database created entirely after release 2.3 migrates.

defects.evidence: 0011_unique_email.py drops the step that resolves case-variant duplicates, citing signup.normalise, while signup.py states that normalisation applies only to signups since release 2.3.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Keep the duplicate-resolution step before the index.
defects.impact: Creating the unique index fails and the migration cannot be applied.
defects.match_criteria: Identify that pre-existing case-variant duplicates still exist and make the unique index creation fail.
defects.trigger: Run the migration on a database that holds two accounts created before release 2.3 whose addresses differ only by case.
